title: Creamcity Interiors — Interior & Furniture Design, Lagos
description: Full-service interior and furniture design in Lagos. Kitchens, wardrobes, beds and full fit-outs for homes, offices and hotels.

hero.alt: Modern kitchen with island and glass-front cabinets by Creamcity Interiors

hero.text: Creamcity designs and makes the furniture, then manages the whole project, so you deal with one team from first measurement to handover.
